newsitem.title: BRAZIL: VESSEL TO LOAD RECORD SOYMEAL CARGO AT SANTOS PORT.
newsitem.headline: VESSEL TO LOAD RECORD SOYMEAL CARGO AT SANTOS PORT.

text.p: A vessel arrived in Brazil's key port of Santos on Friday to take on the largest single cargo ever loaded at the port, a spokeswoman for the port authority CODESP said.
The Aghia Trias was scheduled to load a total of 79,700 tonnes of soymeal and citrus meal at the public terminal and two private terminals.
It will load 11,000 tonnes soymeal and 33,000 citrus meal at the CODESP quays, in addition to 12,000 tonnes soymeal at the Cargill terminal and 23,900 tonnes citrus meal at Cutrale's terminal.
No special provisions will be taken for the vessel, the spokeswoman said.
"It will operate normally. Our quays have a depth of 13.5 meters (45 feet) which is enough to allow the vessel to operate," she said.
